title: Paramount+ Black Friday Deal Drops Monthly Plans Down to $2.99/Month for Movies, Shows & Live Sports
summary: From Nov. 19 to Nov. 30, subscribers can get any Paramount+ monthly plan for just $2.99 per month, with access to hit entertainment and live sports.
contentText:

Beyond entertainment, the deal is especially attractive for sports fans , with access to WNBA, UEFA Champions League soccer, live UFC events and NFL games on CBS. The Nov. 22 Cardinals vs. Chiefs matchup is another reason to tune into Paramount+, particularly for fans hoping for a possible Taylor Swift sighting .

At a Glance: Paramount+ Black Friday Offer

- Deal: Both Paramount+ Essential and Paramount+ Premium for $2.99 per month for the first two months.

- Dates: Nov. 19 through Nov. 30, 2026.

- Paramount+ Essential : $2.99 per month for two months, then $8.99 per month.

- Paramount+ Premium : $2.99 per month for two months, then $13.99 per month.

- Entertainment to watch: South Park , Landman , Tulsa King , Lioness , 1923 and Star Trek: Strange New Worlds , along with a wide selection of movies and Showtime programming.

- Sports to watch: NFL on CBS, UFC, UEFA Champions League, UEFA Women’s Champions League, Zuffa Boxing, college football, college basketball, golf and more. Sports availability varies by plan and event.

STREAM MORE FOR LESS

Paramount+ for $2.99 Per Month

Limited-Time Offer

get paramount+ for $2.99

– Paramount+ Essential includes: Ad-supported streaming, 40,000+ episodes and movies, three simultaneous streams, NFL on CBS, UEFA Champions League, live UFC events and select Showtime series.
– Paramount+ Premium includes: Everything in Essential, an ad-free on-demand experience, 4K UHD and select HDR formats, downloads, live CBS streaming and the full Showtime library.
– This offer does not apply to annual subscriptions.

The most compelling aspect of this promotion is the opportunity to get Paramount+ Premium for the same introductory price as its Paramount+ Essential tier . At just $2.99 per month for the first two months, the offer also stands out among this year’s Black Friday streaming deals.

While competing platforms have rolled out their own seasonal discounts, many still come in above Paramount+’s introductory price, making this one of the more affordable opportunities to add a major streaming service to your lineup.

For viewers looking to stretch their entertainment budget without sacrificing access to premium programming, live sports and a substantial movie and television library, it’s a particularly appealing deal. With the promotion running for just 11 days and ending Nov. 30, there’s a very limited window to take advantage.
